block_instructions: Never read or write .env files or paths matching .env* — use .env.example for documentation only.
Never run destructive shell commands such as rm, del, Remove-Item, mv, move, git rm, git mv, or git clean.
Never use bash -c or powershell -Command to wrap destructive operations.
Never access or modify private key files (*.pem, *.key) or credentials.json.
